claims.text: The resort sits on the white sands of Poipu Beach on Kauai's sunny south shore.

findings.quote: Get away to the soothing white sands of Poipu Beach on Kauai’s sunny south shore at Grand Hyatt Kauai Resort & Spa.
findings.note: The page places the resort on Poipu Beach's white sands on the south shore.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes a low-rise resort on Keoneloa Bay with an open-air design that recalls the island glamour of the 1920s and '30s.

findings.quote: this low-rise Keoneloa Bay resort has an open-air design that recalls the island glamour of the 1920s and ’30s
findings.note: The Condé Nast Traveler review matches the claim exactly.

claims.text: The hotel calls itself an eco-friendly beachfront resort with lush gardens and acres of pools.

findings.quote: This eco-friendly, luxury beachfront oasis with lush gardens and acres of pools offers ocean view dining

findings.quote: For a private dining experience, the resort offers a starlit beachside dinner for two.

claims.text: Connecting rooms are offered for extra space.

claims.text: A lava rock-lined lazy river flows past waterfalls, quiet seating nooks and secret caves, ending at a 150-foot waterslide.

findings.quote: Float down our lava rock-lined lazy river past waterfalls, quiet seating nooks and secret caves to end at our 150-foot waterslide.

findings.quote: Feel the romance of Kauai in thatched-roof bungalows floating above a koi-filled lagoon at the base of a waterfall. Our modern Island cuisine is inspired by local ingredients

findings.quote: Anara Spa in Kauai weaves traditional healing customs to inspire “lokahi”—balance and harmony of the body and spirit.

claims.text: Pool Suites overlook the multilevel pools and have a walk-in wet room, a double shower and a free-standing French tub.

findings.quote: Overlooking our multilevel pools, these suites feature contemporary Hawaiian furnishings, one king bed, full sleeper sofa, sitting area, and large bath with a walk-in wet room, double shower and free-standing French tub.
